test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Speed of six bikes T1, T2, T3, T4, T5 and T6 are compared. Speed of T6 is more than only three bikes. No two bikes have same speed. Speed of T4 is more than T2 but less than T6. Speed of T3 is not less than T5. Speed of T2 is not least. Speed of which bikes can be more than T4?

I. T3

II. T1
solution:
**Given : **

 
• Speed of six bikes T1, T2, T3, T4, T5 and T6 are compared.
 
• No two bikes have same speed. 

**Explanation :**

1) Speed of T6 is more than only three bikes.

2) Speed of T4 is more than T2 but less than T6.

3) Speed of T2 is not least.

_ > _ > T6 > T4 > T2 > _

4) Speed of T3 is not less than T5.

As position of T5 is not known yet, therefore there are two possible positions for T5.

After positioning T5 and T3 only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e T1.

T3 > T1 / T5 > T6 > T4 > T2 > T1 / T5

Thus, according to the final arrangement Speed of three bikes i.e T3, T6 and either T1 or T5 is more than T4.

Therefore, 

I. T3 → It has more speed than T4.

II. T1 → It has more speed than T4.

Hence, **"Both I and II"** is the correct answer.
